items.summary:
Christopher Woolcott has today been given a 2-year prison sentence, suspended for 2 years, after staging a £154m fake takeover bid for Touchstone Exploration Inc.

He was also ordered to complete 200 hours of unpaid work and to pay costs of £4,627.73.Mr Woolcott built a sizeable stake in Touchstone, an oil and gas listed company. items.summary:
Workplace pension providers could have greater flexibility to invest for the long term under proposals from the FCA, helping them deliver better outcomes for savers while ensuring savers' interests remain protected.

The FCA is consulting on excluding certain performance-linked fees from the charge cap for default funds in workplace pensions it regulates.Performance-linked fees are common in private markets, including private equity, venture capital and private credit.
